what_to_detect: An Aura on the battlefield that its host can no longer legally carry (protection, changed type) moves to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check after the resolution, while the host stays on the battlefield.
near_miss: An Aura whose host gained a characteristic that leaves it legal, and which stays attached.
record_fields: effect-half zone_change battlefield to graveyard attributed unresolved on an Aura

what_to_detect: An Aura that becomes a creature in the record becomes unattached and moves to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
near_miss: A noncreature Aura touched by the same effect that stays attached.
record_fields: type_change event adding creature to an Aura

what_to_detect: When a second Role controlled by the same player becomes attached to a permanent, the older such Role moves to the graveyard in the state-based check.
near_miss: A Role entering attached to a permanent that has no other Role under the same controller.
record_fields: token_created and attached events for the Role
zone_change battlefield to graveyard unresolved on the older Role
snapshot of attached Roles and controllers
